stem.text: In the potentiometer circuit shown, the reading on the ammeter is zero.

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit: a power supply with two terminals connected across a uniform metal wire. A sliding contact connects through an ammeter, labelled A, to a middle point between two resistors. One of the resistors has light arrows drawn on it. Labels: power supply, sliding contact, uniform metal wire.

stem.text: The light-dependent resistor (LDR) is then covered and the ammeter gives a non-zero reading.
Which change could return the ammeter reading to zero?

C.text: moving the sliding contact to the left

D.text: moving the sliding contact to the right
